name: Xiaomi TV EA Pro 55" (MiTV-MTEQ0, baymax, MediaTek), China firmware 23.6.26.4028
warnings: With the standard com.gathin.tvhome ID, disabling com.mitv.tvhome leaves FallbackHome (a black screen). - Network ADB closes at every boot: com.xiaomi.mitv.settings writes adb_enabled=0 a few seconds after boot.

Android then drops any accessibility service of those apps, so do not rely on an accessibility helper on this set. - com.xiaomi.mitv.upgrade and com.mediatek.TimeMeasurementAgent are persistent: the firmware starts them at boot even when disabled.
